item.artDescription: This work bears a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Torlög Pætærson</color> being defeated by <color=#D09B61FF>Hazel 'rachel' Rella</color> with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Torlög</color>'s eyes are closed. The lower part of the image is dominated by a district. The work has a dadaist feeling and an unbalanced structure. This representation tells the story of the defeating of <color=#D09B61FF>Torlög</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>rachel</color> with a semi-automatic rifle on 11th of Jugust, 5500.
This furniture bears a depiction of a politician eating a pumpkin. An imp poses to the left of the main scene. The work makes the viewer think of thrusting.

An engraving on this furniture represents <color=#D09B61FF>Manuel 'travis' Dunlap</color> deeply kissing <color=#D09B61FF>Kalen 'serenity' Hester</color> with few clothes in sight. <color=#D09B61FF>Travis</color> is locking eyes with <color=#D09B61FF>serenity</color>. The image is bordered by several cones. The work is infused with the idea of patience and is done in a pixelated style. This representation relates to <color=#D09B61FF>travis</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>serenity</color> becoming lovers on 6th of Aprimay, 5500.

この家具には,ビーストが数百体のスズメ達とルーレットをしている描写が彫られている.主題から離れた場所にある一つの小川は,「苦痛」を作者の立場から表しているようだ.この作品は「密接」を象徴しているようだ.
